entities.summary: Rosa Rosà was a writer and author associated with the inter-war Italian Futurist movement. She is renowned for her first short novel, Una donna con tre anime. Rosa Rosà was a painters & sculptors from Vienna (1884-11-18, Vienna–1978). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
